I haven't set up the Monday digest yet, so nothing will post automatically on 19 October.

The setup agent I asked to fix that couldn't run either, because its AI sign-in has expired. Someone with Control UI admin access needs to restore the Gateway sign-in (Models in the Control UI, or `openclaw configure`). Once that's done, I can create the job.

I've posted the same explanation in #coastal-team.

When the digest is set up, it will cover the previous week's posts in #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items. Finance figures such as rates, discounts and contract values will be left out and flagged for Anselm or June instead. I didn't use the knowledge brain because its search returned nothing.
